assertions.assertion: CPT 93229 is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code I47.1 corresponds to supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I25.10 corresponds to atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The ordering note states the above
The payer letter states this decision does not preclude a corrected claim or appeal
The appeal requests reconsideration of the authorization requirement
The appeal requests payment of the outstanding balance of 702.81
